changeSet.author: pc
changeSet.comment: lib-jobs v0.2.0+ backfill (1/2): copy existing jobs.log text into a staging column before the lib-jobs library changeset (db/migration/lib-jobs/changes/002-job-logs-table.json, included from changelog-master.json right after this directory) creates job_logs and drops jobs.log. The library changeset does both in one atomic changeSet, so the copy has to happen before it runs, not in between. See lib-jobs DESIGN.md section 8.

sql.sql: UPDATE jobs SET log_backfill = log WHERE log IS NOT NULL
